    // ── Calculate for the single selected trade customer ────────
c.calculateSingleTrade = function() {

    if (!c.data.selectedTradeRow) return;

    var current = parseFloat(c.data.selectedTradeRow.current_limit) || 0;

    var raw = c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_additional;

    // ✅ STEP 1: Handle EMPTY input
    if (raw === '' || raw === null || raw === undefined) {
        c.data.selectedTradeRow.total_requested = current;
        c.data.requestedLimit = 0;
        c.data.calc = {};   // ]]>🔥<![CDATA[ CLEAR live calculation
        return;
    }

    var add = parseFloat(raw);

    var total = current + add;

    // ❌ Only block NEGATIVE
    if (total < 0) {
        alert("Total Limit Requested cannot be negative");

        c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_additional = 0;
        c.data.selectedTradeRow.total_requested = current;
        c.data.requestedLimit = current;
        return;
    }

    // ✅ Valid
    c.data.selectedTradeRow.total_requested = total;
    c.data.requestedLimit = total;

    // ]]>🚨<![CDATA[ IMPORTANT: only calculate if > 0
    if (total > 0) {
        c.recalculate();
    } else {
        c.data.calc = {}; // hide panel when total = 0
    }
};

    // ── Clear customer data ─────────────────────────────────────
    c.clearCustomerData = function() {
        c.data.customerSysId         = '';
        c.data.customerName          = '';
        c.data.customerType          = '';
        c.data.segment               = '';
        c.data.calc                  = {};
        c.data.activeSD              = 0;
        c.data.outstanding           = 0;
        c.data.sites                 = [];
        c.data.sitesCount            = 0;
        c.data.sitesTotalRequested   = 0;
        c.data.selectedTradeRow      = null;
        c.data.requestedLimit        = 0;
    };

    // ── Load sites for Non-Trade ────────────────────────────────
    c.loadSites = function(customerSysId, pan) {
        c.server.get({
            action: 'loadSites',
            customerSysId: customerSysId,
            pan: pan
        }).then(function(r) {
            if (r.data.sites && r.data.sites.length > 0) {
                c.data.sites      = r.data.sites;
                c.data.sitesCount = r.data.sites.length;
                c.recalculateSites();
            } else {
                c.data.sites      = [];
                c.data.sitesCount = 0;
            }
        });
    };

    // ── Recalculate sites (Non-Trade) ───────────────────────────
    c.recalculateSites = function() {
        if (!c.data.sites || c.data.sites.length === 0) {
            c.data.sitesTotalRequested = 0;
            c.data.sitesCount = 0;
            return;
        }
        var total = 0, count = 0;
        c.data.sites.forEach(function(site) {
            var req = parseFloat(site.requested_limit) || 0;
            if (req > 0) { total += req; count++; }
        });
        c.data.sitesTotalRequested = total / 100000;
        c.data.sitesCount          = count;
        c.data.sitesValidationError = (c.data.sitesTotalRequested === 0)
            ? 'All requested credit must be allocated to sites. Total cannot be 0.'
            : '';
        c.data.requestedLimit = total;
        c.recalculate();
    };

    // ── Live recalculate ────────────────────────────────────────
    c.recalculate = function() {
        if (c.data.customerType === 'Non-Trade') return;
        var req = parseFloat(c.data.requestedLimit) || 0;
        if (req <= 0 || !c.data.customerSysId) { c.data.calc = {}; return; }

        c.server.get({
            action:          'calculate',
            customerType:    c.data.customerType || 'Trade',
            customerSysId:   c.data.customerSysId,
            requestedLimit:  req,
            activeSD:        parseFloat(c.data.activeSD)        || 0,
            outstanding:     parseFloat(c.data.outstanding)     || 0,
            avgMonthlySales: parseFloat(c.data.avgMonthlySales) || 0,
            salesLastMonth:  parseFloat(c.data.salesLastMonth)  || 0,
            salesPrevMonth:  parseFloat(c.data.salesPrevMonth)  || 0,
            segment:         c.data.segment   || 'Cement',
            cg2Code:         c.data.cg2Code   || '',
            vintageDays:     parseInt(c.data.vintageDays) || 0
        }).then(function(r) {
    if (r.data.calc) {
        c.data.calc = angular.copy(r.data.calc);  // ]]>🔥<![CDATA[ FORCE UI REFRESH
    }
});
    };

    // ── Save Draft ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    c.saveDraft = function() {
        c.data.saving = true;
        c.server.get({ action: 'saveDraft', form: c.buildPayload() })
        .then(function(r) {
            c.data.saving        = false;
            c.data.draftSysId    = r.data.sysId;
            c.data.requestNumber = r.data.number;
        });
    };

    // ── Submit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
 c.submit = function() {
    c.data.submitError = '';

    // 1. Must have a customer selected
    if (!c.data.selectedCustomerSysId) {
        c.data.submitError = 'Please select a customer.';
        return;
    }

    // 2. Segment must exist (debug: log it)
   /* if (!c.data.segment || c.data.segment === '') {
        c.data.submitError = 'Customer segment is missing. Please re-select the customer.';
        return;
    } */

    // 3. For Trade, must have entered an additional limit
    if (c.data.customerType === 'Trade') {
        if (!c.data.selectedTradeRow) {
            c.data.submitError = 'Please select a customer first.';
            return;
        }
        var addl = parseFloat(c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_additional) || 0;
        if (addl <= 0) {
            c.data.submitError = 'Please enter the additional limit amount to request.';
            return;
        }
    }

    // 4. Business justification — always required
    if (!c.data.justification || c.data.justification.trim().length < 20) {
        c.data.submitError = 'Business justification must be at least 20 characters.';
        return;
    }

    // 5. Deviation justification — only if deviation
    if (c.data.calc && c.data.calc.isDeviation) {
        if (!c.data.deviationJustification || c.data.deviationJustification.trim().length < 20) {
            c.data.submitError = 'Deviation justification is required (min 20 characters).';
            return;
        }
    }

    // 6. Non-Trade site validation
    if (c.data.customerType === 'Non-Trade') {
        if (!c.data.sitesTotalRequested || c.data.sitesTotalRequested === 0) {
            c.data.submitError = 'All requested credit must be allocated to sites. Total cannot be 0.';
            return;
        }
        if (c.data.sitesValidationError) {
            c.data.submitError = c.data.sitesValidationError;
            return;
        }
    }

    // ✅ All validations passed — submit
    c.data.submitting  = true;
    c.data.submitError = '';

    c.server.get({ action: 'submit', form: c.buildPayload() })
  .then(function(r) {
        c.data.submitting = false;
        if (r.data.success) {
            c.data.submitted        = true;
            c.data.requestNumber    = r.data.requestNumber;
            c.data.approverRole     = r.data.approverRole;
            c.data.isDeviation      = r.data.isDeviation;
            // ── Clear calc so no stale deviation alerts show ──
            c.data.calc             = {};
        } else {
            c.data.submitError = r.data.error || 'Submission failed. Please try again.';
        }
    }).catch(function(err) {
        c.data.submitting  = false;
        c.data.submitError = 'Server error. Please try again.';
    });
};

    // ── Reset ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    c.resetForm = function() {
        c.data = {
            calc: {}, submitted: false, submitting: false, saving: false,
            searchTerm: '', searchResults: [], selectedCustomerSysId: '',
            suggestions: [], suggestionIndex: -1, suggestionSelected: false,
            sites: [], sitesCount: 0, sitesTotalRequested: 0,
            selectedTradeRow: null
        };
    };

    // ── Build payload ───────────────────────────────────────────
    c.buildPayload = function() {
        var payload = {
            customerSysId:         c.data.selectedCustomerSysId,
            customerType:          c.data.customerType,
            segment:               c.data.segment,
            requestedLimit:        c.data.requestedLimit,
            activeSD:              c.data.activeSD              || 0,
            outstanding:           c.data.outstanding           || 0,
					currentCreditLimit: (c.data.selectedTradeRow && c.data.selectedTradeRow.current_limit) || 0,
					panLevelCL: c.data.panlevelCL || 0,
            avgMonthlySales:       c.data.avgMonthlySales       || 0,
            salesLastMonth:        c.data.salesLastMonth        || 0,
            salesPrevMonth:        c.data.salesPrevMonth        || 0,
            chequeBounces:         c.data.chequeBounces         || 0,
            marketPerception:      c.data.marketPerception      || '',
            justification:         c.data.justification,
            deviationJustification: c.data.deviationJustification || '',
            isDeviation:           c.data.calc.isDeviation,
            vintageDays:           c.data.vintageDays           || 0,
            draftSysId:            c.data.draftSysId            || ''
        };

        // Trade: send the single selected customer
        if (c.data.customerType === 'Trade' && c.data.selectedTradeRow) {
            payload.tradeCustomers = [{
                customer_code:        c.data.selectedTradeRow.customer_code,
                current_limit:        c.data.selectedTradeRow.current_limit,
                active_sd:            c.data.selectedTradeRow.active_sd,
                outstanding:          c.data.selectedTradeRow.outstanding,
                requested_additional: c.data.selectedTradeRow.requested_additional,
                total_requested:      c.data.selectedTradeRow.total_requested
            }];
        }

        // Non-Trade: send sites
        if (c.data.customerType === 'Non-Trade' && c.data.sites && c.data.sites.length > 0) {
            payload.sites = c.data.sites.map(function(s) {
                return {
                    site_code:         s.site_code,
                    depot:             s.depot,
                    location:          s.location,
                    current_limit:     parseFloat(s.current_limit)      || 0,
                    outstanding:       parseFloat(s.outstanding)         || 0,
                    project_potential: parseFloat(s.project_potential)   || 0,
                    monthly_volume:    parseFloat(s.monthly_volume)      || 0,
                    requested_limit:   parseFloat(s.requested_limit)     || 0
                };
            }).filter(function(s) { return s.requested_limit > 0; });
        }

        return payload;
    };
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>  /* ============================================================
